name: Nat.lt_left_add
statement: theorem Nat.lt_left_add {a b c : Nat} (h₁ : a + b < c) : a < c
proof:
:= by
  induction b with
  | zero => exact h₁
  | succ n ih =>
    have h₂ := Nat.lt_succ_of_lt h₁
    rw [Nat.add_succ] at h₂
    have h₃ := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h₂
    apply ih h₃

name: Nat.le_trans_lt
statement: theorem Nat.le_trans_lt {a b c : Nat} (h₁ : a ≤ b) (h₂ : b < c) : a < c
proof:
:= by
  cases h₁ with
  | refl   => exact h₂
  | step h => apply Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_of_le h) h₂

name: Context.Wellformed.empty
proof:
:= by
  intro l₁ l₂; simp [Context.empty]; intro l₁_nil l₂_nil; simp [*]

name: Size.max_val_gt_zero
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | double => simp [Size.max_val]
  | quad   => simp [Size.max_val]

name: Bytes.length_cons
statement: theorem Bytes.length_cons : Bytes.length (.cons b bs) = Nat.succ (Bytes.length bs)

name: Bytes.length_rev
statement: theorem Bytes.length_rev : ∀ acc, Bytes.length (reverse.rev bytes acc) = Bytes.length bytes + Bytes.length acc
proof:
:= by
  induction bytes
  case fst b =>
    exact fun acc => by
      simp only [
        reverse.rev,
        length_cons,
        Nat.succ_eq_add_one,
        length_fst,
        Nat.add_comm
      ]
  case cons b bs ih =>
    intro acc
    simp [reverse.rev, ih, length_cons, length_cons, Nat.succ_add_eq_add_succ]

name: Bytes.length_reverse
statement: theorem Bytes.length_reverse : Bytes.length (Bytes.reverse bytes) = Bytes.length bytes
proof:
:= by
  cases bytes <;> simp [reverse]
  case cons b bs => simp [length_rev, length_fst, length_cons]
